start_angle.description: Where the arc starts, radians from +X, counter-clockwise.

sweep.description: How far it turns, radians: positive counter-clockwise.

Copies.description:
A grid of copies of a part: copy (column c, row r) is the part moved by (c·dx, r·dy)
mm.

dx.description: Distance from copy to copy along X, mm; negative grows to the left.

dy.description: Distance from copy to copy along Y, mm; negative grows downwards.

order.description:
`by_operation`: each operation on every copy, then the next; `by_copy`: every
operation on one copy, then the next copy.

CopyOrder.description: In which order the copies are cut.

oneOf.description: Each operation on every copy, then the next operation.

Every operation on one copy, then the next copy. Called `by_part` before parts
came (schema 22).

CornerChoice.description: A corner with its own bone, chosen by the user.

along.description:
The wall a T-bone runs along, `longer` or `shorter`: the notch is in the other.
Required with a T-bone; null otherwise.

Corners.description:
How the tool reaches into the inside corners it would leave round, so a square part
fits: every corner on the tool's side up to `max_angle`.

oneOf.description: In along the corner's bisector.

max_angle.description: Only corners this sharp or sharper, radians (1.745 = 100°).

oneOf.description: In along the longer wall: the notch is in the shorter one.

max_angle.description: Only corners this sharp or sharper, radians (1.745 = 100°).

CustomPost.description: A user post-processor's config and template, exactly as read from the posts folder.

config.description: The post's settings file (TOML), as copied.

Drawing.description:
The project's drawing: shapes in millimetres, or (only for jobs from before v4) a
reference to a DXF that still has to be embedded.

dxfs.description:
The DXFs the imported shapes came from, each as at its last import or update, with
its own placement.

hidden.description:
Groups and layers not drawn on the canvas (they are still cut): `dxf:1`,
`dxf:1/layer:Cut`, `image:1`, `text:1`, `drawn:circle`, `drawn:rectangle`,
`drawn:polyline`.

images.description: Pictures traced into shapes, for V-carving.

next_shape_id.description: The id the next new shape gets. Ids are never reused.

texts.description:
Texts written into shapes, for V-carving, pocketing or profiling. Left out of the
file when there are none, so projects without text open in older versions.

flattened.description: How many curves of each type (splines, ellipses) were turned into arcs.

format.description: What kind of file it is: a DXF or an SVG.

id.description: The DXF's id, which its shapes and selectors name.

ignored.description: How many entities of each type were left out (text, dimensions, …).

imported.description: How many entities of each type were imported.

issues.description: What the import found: the import report.

name.description:
Its name in the Browser and messages; the file's name without its extension
at first.

placement.description: How the imported drawing was moved, turned and scaled on the stock.

px_per_inch.description:
An SVG without a real size: the pixels per inch chosen for it, used again on update.
None for a DXF and an SVG with real units.

sha256.description: The DXF's SHA-256, to tell whether it changed.

units.description: The DXF's units: `mm` or `inch`. Inch drawings are converted to mm on import.

units_from.description: Where the units came from: the DXF itself, or the user's choice.

Entry.description:
How the tool goes down into the material at the start of each pass, for pockets and
follow paths (a profile always spirals: its `ramp_angle`).

oneOf.description: Straight down: needs a centre-cutting tool. An empty struct variant, as `Rings`.

Down along the path and back, never steeper than `ramp_angle` (radians,
0 < angle <= 30°).

ramp_angle.description: The steepest the ramp goes, radians: more than 0, at most 30° (0.5236).

oneOf.description:
Pockets only: down round a circle of `radius` (the tool centre's), never steeper
than `ramp_angle`.

radius.description: The helix's radius, mm: less than the tool radius.

ramp_angle.description: The steepest the helix goes, radians: more than 0, at most 30° (0.5236).

Finish.description: A finishing pass on a profile.

stock.description: Left on the wall by the roughing passes, mm: more than 0, less than the tool radius.

oneOf.description: Straight down at the hole's centre, `peck` mm at a time.

peck.description:
Drill this many mm at a time, lifting out between pecks to clear chips. Null: in
one go.

oneOf.description:
A helix at the wall, at most `step_down` mm per turn and never steeper than
`ramp_angle` (radians, 0 < angle <= 30°), then one level circle.

direction.description: `climb` or `conventional`, as for a profile inside the hole.

ramp_angle.description: The steepest the helix goes, radians: more than 0, at most 30° (0.5236).

step_down.description: The most the helix goes down per turn, mm.

Image.description:
A picture traced into shapes: the picture itself, where it goes, and how it becomes black
and white. Its traced shapes are `path` shapes on its layer that name it in `image`.

arcs.description: Traced edges are fitted with arcs as well as lines.

blur.description: Blur before the threshold, in pixels, 0 to 10; 0: none.

data.description: The picture file itself (PNG, JPEG or BMP), base64-encoded.

id.description: The image's id, which its traced shapes name.

invert.description: Carve the light parts instead of the dark ones.

layer.description: The layer its traced shapes go on.

min_area.description: Black or white specks smaller than this are dropped, mm², 0 to 100.

rotation.description:
Turned counter-clockwise about the picture's centre, degrees, at least 0 and less
than 360. `x`, `y` and `width` are before the turn; the traced shapes are turned
after the trace.

smoothing.description: How far a traced edge may be simplified away from the picture's edge, mm, 0.01 to 1.

threshold.description:
Grey values below this (0–255) are black: 1 to 254, or "auto" to pick it from the
picture (Otsu's method).

trace.description:
What it is traced into: the black parts' outlines (for a V-carve) or their centre
lines (for a follow path).

width.description: The picture's width on the stock, mm; its height follows from the picture.

x.description: X of the picture's lower-left corner on the stock, mm.

y.description: Y of the picture's lower-left corner on the stock, mm.

anyOf.description: Grey values below this are black, 1 to 254.

ImageThreshold.description: Where grey turns black: "auto" or a grey value.

ImageTrace.description: What a picture is traced into.

oneOf.description: Closed outlines round the black parts, black inside.
Open (or closed) paths along the black strokes' middles.

radius.description:
Radius of the lead arcs, mm: more than 0, at most 10 tool diameters. Smaller where
there's no room.

custom_post.description:
Your own post-processor, copied into the project when chosen, so it gives the same
G-code anywhere. Null: `post` is a built-in one.

gcode_units.description:
The units the G-code is written in: `mm` (G21) or `inch` (G20). Everything else in
the project stays in mm. Since schema 28.

library_uid.description:
The `uid` of the machine profile these values came from, for reference; nothing
that cuts reads it. Null: not from a profile.

max_feed.description:
The machine's fastest feed, mm/min: higher feeds are refused, and the cycle time
uses it for rapids. Null: unknown.

name.description: The machine profile these values came from, for reference; nothing reads it.

post.description: The post-processor: `grbl`, `linuxcnc`, `mach3`, or the name of your own.

safe_z.description: The height for rapid moves sideways, mm above Z0. Above the stock top.

tool_change.description:
With several tools: `files` (one file per tool) or `program` (one file with tool
changes).

travel.description:
The machine's travel, mm. When set, a program that moves farther is refused. Null:
not checked.

work_zero.description:
The point of the drawing that becomes X0 Y0 in the G-code. Missing: the drawing's
origin.

MaterialRef.description: A library material, as a project names it.

name.description: Its name when chosen, shown when the library no longer has it.

clearance.description:
How far the cut moves into the material that is kept, mm: positive removes more (a
larger pocket, a smaller part), negative leaves material. Less than the tool radius.

corner_choices.description:
Corners with their own bone, whatever `corners` says. Missing or empty: none. Left
out when empty.

corners.description:
Dogbones or T-bones in the inside corners, so square parts fit. Null: the corners
stay round.

enabled.description: False: the operation stays in the project but isn't cut. Missing: true.

end_depth.description:
Where the cut ends, mm down from the stock top. More than the start depth; below the
stock bottom only within `stock.max_overcut`.

finish.description:
A finishing pass: the roughing passes leave `stock` mm on the wall, and one last lap
at full depth takes it off. Null: none.

material.description: The library material its feeds come from. Null: its own values.

name.description: A name for the operation, shown in the list and on the setup sheet. Empty: none.

part.description: The id of the part it belongs to (`parts`).

plunge_feed.description: The feed going down into the material, mm/min.

ramp_angle.description:
The steepest the spiral ramp goes down along the contour, radians: more than 0, at
most 30° (0.5236). A profile always spirals down (docs/specs/profile-always-spiral.md).

select.description: What the operation cuts: the shapes on a layer, or shapes by id.

side.description:
Which side of the line the tool cuts: `outside` (cutting a part out), `inside` (a
hole) or `on` the line.

skin.description:
An onion skin: the passes stop `thickness` mm above the end depth, and one last lap
cuts through it. Null: none.

start_depth.description:
Where the cut starts, mm down from the stock top: 0 for the top, more when an
earlier operation already cut down to there.

starts.description:
Where the cut starts, as points in drawing coordinates (mm): each moves the start of
the ring (contour) nearest to it. Empty: chosen by Chipload.

step_down.description:
The deepest each pass goes, mm. The passes are equal, and the last one ends exactly
at the end depth.

tabs.description:
Holding tabs left at the bottom of the cut, so a part cut out doesn't come loose.
Null: none.

through.description:
Cut through the stock: how far below the stock bottom it ends, mm. The end depth is
then the stock thickness plus this, and follows the thickness. Null: the end depth as
set.

tool.description: The id of the project tool it cuts with (`tools`).

clearance.description:
How far the cut moves into the material that is kept, mm: positive removes more (a
larger pocket, a smaller part), negative leaves material. Less than the tool radius.

corner_choices.description:
Corners with their own bone, whatever `corners` says. Missing or empty: none. Left
out when empty.

corners.description:
Dogbones or T-bones in the inside corners, so square parts fit. Null: the corners
stay round.

enabled.description: False: the operation stays in the project but isn't cut. Missing: true.

end_depth.description:
Where the cut ends, mm down from the stock top. More than the start depth; below the
stock bottom only within `stock.max_overcut`.

entry.description:
How the tool goes down at the start of each pass: `plunge` (straight down; needs a
centre-cutting tool) or `ramp` along the path; pockets also `helix`. Missing:
plunge.

lead.description:
A quarter-circle lead-in and lead-out from the cleared side onto the wall. Null:
none.

material.description: The library material its feeds come from. Null: its own values.

name.description: A name for the operation, shown in the list and on the setup sheet. Empty: none.

part.description: The id of the part it belongs to (`parts`).

plunge_feed.description: The feed going down into the material, mm/min.

rest.description:
Rest machining: clear only what a larger tool leaves in these shapes. Null: the
whole pocket.

rest_passes.description:
Rest passes: smaller endmills that clear what this pocket's tool (or the pass before)
leaves, in its shapes and depths. Missing or empty: none. Left out when empty.

select.description: What the operation cuts: the shapes on a layer, or shapes by id.

start_depth.description:
Where the cut starts, mm down from the stock top: 0 for the top, more when an
earlier operation already cut down to there.

starts.description:
Where each wall ring starts, as points in drawing coordinates (mm): each moves the
start of the wall ring nearest to it. Empty: chosen by Chipload.

step_down.description:
The deepest each pass goes, mm. The passes are equal, and the last one ends exactly
at the end depth.

stepover.description:
The distance between the clearing rings, as a fraction of the tool diameter: more
than 0, at most 1.

through.description:
Cut through the stock: how far below the stock bottom it ends, mm. The end depth is
then the stock thickness plus this, and follows the thickness. Null: the end depth as
set.

tool.description: The id of the project tool it cuts with (`tools`).

oneOf.description:
V-carve: a V-bit follows the centre line of closed shapes, as deep as makes the cut
exactly as wide as the shape.

enabled.description: False: the operation stays in the project but isn't cut. Missing: true.

end_depth.description:
The deepest the V-bit's tip may go, mm down from the stock top. Strokes that need
more are carved to it, narrower than drawn, with a warning.

feed.description: The feed, mm/min, for moves no steeper than 45°.

material.description: The library material its feeds come from. Null: its own values.

name.description: A name for the operation, shown in the list and on the setup sheet. Empty: none.

part.description: The id of the part it belongs to (`parts`).

plunge_feed.description: The feed for moves steeper than 45°, mm/min.

select.description: What the operation cuts: the shapes on a layer, or shapes by id.

start_depth.description:
The surface carved, mm down from the stock top: 0 for the top, more to carve on a
floor an earlier pocket cut.

step_down.description: Carve in passes no deeper than this, mm. Null: one pass.

tool.description: The id of the project tool it cuts with (`tools`).

oneOf.description: Follow path: the tool centre on the selected shapes, open or closed.

enabled.description: False: the operation stays in the project but isn't cut. Missing: true.

end_depth.description:
Where the cut ends, mm down from the stock top. More than the start depth; below the
stock bottom only within `stock.max_overcut`.

entry.description: How the tool goes down at the start of each pass: `plunge` or `ramp` along the path.

material.description: The library material its feeds come from. Null: its own values.

name.description: A name for the operation, shown in the list and on the setup sheet. Empty: none.

part.description: The id of the part it belongs to (`parts`).

plunge_feed.description: The feed going down into the material, mm/min.

select.description: What the operation cuts: the shapes on a layer, or shapes by id.

Where the cut starts, mm down from the stock top: 0 for the top, more when an
earlier operation already cut down to there.

step_down.description:
The deepest each pass goes, mm. The passes are equal, and the last one ends exactly
at the end depth.

through.description:
Cut through the stock: how far below the stock bottom it ends, mm. The end depth is
then the stock thickness plus this, and follows the thickness. Null: the end depth as
set.

tool.description: The id of the project tool it cuts with (`tools`).

oneOf.description: Holes: drilled with a drill, bored with a helix with an endmill.

enabled.description: False: the operation stays in the project but isn't cut. Missing: true.

end_depth.description:
Where the hole ends, mm down from the stock top. For a drill, the depth of its
point.

feed.description: A bore's feed round its helix and bottom circle, mm/min. A drill doesn't use it.

material.description: The library material its feeds come from. Null: its own values.

method.description: How the holes are cut: `drill` with a drill, or `bore` (a helix) with an endmill.

name.description: A name for the operation, shown in the list and on the setup sheet. Empty: none.

part.description: The id of the part it belongs to (`parts`).

plunge_feed.description: A drill's feed down, or a bore's feed straight down to the start depth, mm/min.

select.description:
What the operation cuts: the circles among the shapes on a layer, or shapes by id.
Other shapes are skipped with a note.

start_depth.description:
Where the cut starts, mm down from the stock top: 0 for the top, more when an
earlier operation already cut down to there.

through.description:
Cut through the stock: how far below the stock bottom it ends, mm. The end depth is
then the stock thickness plus this, and follows the thickness. Null: the end depth as
set.

tool.description: The id of the project tool it cuts with (`tools`).

oneOf.description: Surface: the whole stock top taken down flat, in straight passes back and forth.

enabled.description: False: the operation stays in the project but isn't cut. Missing: true.

end_depth.description: How far down the stock top is taken, mm. At most the stock thickness.

material.description: The library material its feeds come from. Null: its own values.

name.description: A name for the operation, shown in the list and on the setup sheet. Empty: none.

part.description:
The id of the part it belongs to (`parts`). The stock is faced once, whatever copies
the part has.

plunge_feed.description: The feed going down beside the stock to each depth, mm/min.

start_depth.description: Where the cut starts, mm down from the stock top: 0 for the top.

step_down.description:
The deepest each pass goes, mm. The passes are equal, and the last one ends exactly
at the end depth.

stepover.description:
The distance between passes, as a fraction of the tool diameter: at least 0.1, at
most 0.9.

tool.description: The id of the project tool it cuts with (`tools`): an endmill.

Part.description:
A part: a named group of operations, cut together, with its own copies
(docs/specs/parts.md §2). It owns no geometry: its operations select the shapes.

copies.description: Cut the part several times in a grid. Null: once.

enabled.description: False: the part and all its operations stay in the project but aren't cut.

id.description: Its number, unique in the project: what operations name it by.

name.description: Its name, unique in the project, shown in the Browser, the report and the sheet.

Placement.description:
Where the imported drawing is put: a DXF point p goes to scale · rotate(p) + (dx, dy),
turned and scaled about the DXF's origin.

rotation.description:
Turned counter-clockwise about the DXF's origin, degrees, at least 0 and less than
360, after the scale. Multiples of 90 are exact.

scale.description: Scaled about the DXF's origin by this factor, 0.001 to 1000; 1: as drawn.

Rest.description:
Rest machining: the pocket clears only the material the larger tool `after_tool` can't
reach in its shapes.

after_tool.description: The id of the larger project tool whose leftovers this pocket clears.

RestPass.description:
One rest pass of a pocket (docs/specs/rest-passes.md §2): it takes the pocket's shapes,
depths, clearance and direction, and clears only what the tool before it leaves.

enabled.description: False: kept, but not cut. Missing: true.

entry.description: How the tool goes down: `plunge`, `ramp` or `helix`.

plunge_feed.description: The feed going down into the material, mm/min.

step_down.description: The deepest each pass goes, mm.

stepover.description: The distance between the clearing rings, as a fraction of the tool diameter.

tool.description:
The id of the project tool it cuts with (`tools`): an endmill smaller than the tool
before it.

dxf.description: Only shapes from this DXF (an id in `drawing.dxfs`).

exclude.description:
Shapes of that DXF, image or text left out (ids); with `dxf`, `image` or `text`
only. A contour with any of them isn't cut. A traced image's, or a text's, are found
again when it is made again.

image.description: Only shapes traced from this image (an id in `drawing.images`).

layer.description: Every shape on this layer (upper or lower case don't matter).

text.description: Only the letters of this text (an id in `drawing.texts`).

Shape.description:
One shape of the drawing: imported from a DXF (`path`: lines and arcs, one shape per DXF
entity), or drawn in Chipload (`circle`, `rectangle`, `polyline`). One flat object:
`id`, `layer`, `kind`, then the fields of that kind.

angle.description:
rectangle: its rotation about the centre; polygon: the angle of its first corner from
+X; radians, counter-clockwise.

bulges.description:
polyline: one per segment, as in DXF: tan(sweep / 4); 0 straight, 1 a
counter-clockwise half circle, -1 clockwise.

center.description: circle, rectangle, polygon: the centre, mm.

closed.description: path, polyline: whether it ends where it starts.

construction.description:
circle, rectangle, polygon, polyline: construction geometry, shown and snapped to but
never cut; left out when false.

corner_radius.description: rectangle: the radius of its corners, mm; 0 for sharp ones.

dxf.description: path: the DXF it was imported from (its id in `drawing.dxfs`).

dxf_handle.description:
path: the handle of the DXF entity it came from, which keeps its id when the DXF is
updated.

dxf_type.description: path: the DXF entity's type, e.g. LWPOLYLINE.

id.description: The shape's id, which operations select it by.

image.description: path: the image it was traced from; absent for shapes from a DXF.

kind.description:
`path` (imported from a DXF), or a shape drawn in Chipload: `circle`, `rectangle`,
`polyline`.

length.description: rectangle: its size along its own X axis, mm.

name.description: circle, rectangle, polyline: its name in the Browser; left out when it has none.

radius.description: circle: the radius, mm; polygon: the radius to its corners, mm.

segments.description: path: its lines and arcs, mm.

sides.description: polygon: how many sides (and corners) it has, 3 to 1000.

text.description: path: the text it is a letter of (its id in `drawing.texts`).

width.description: rectangle: its size along its own Y axis, mm.

Skin.description: An onion skin on a profile.

thickness.description: Left above the end depth until the last lap, mm: more than 0, at most the step down.

SourceIssue.description: An import-time issue that can't be recomputed from the shapes.

code.description:
What kind of issue, e.g. `duplicate` or `open_contour` (see the import page of the
guide).

oneOf.description: M3
M4

fit.description:
Centred on the drawing only: its size is the drawing's outline plus this margin each
side, mm, following the drawing; `x` and `y` are then used only while the drawing is
empty. Null: the size is `x` × `y`.

material.description:
The project's material: new operations take it, with its values. Each operation
names its own (`material` on the operation). Null: none.

max_overcut.description: How far a cut may go below the stock bottom, into the spoilboard, mm.

origin.description:
Where the stock lies: its `bottom_left` corner or its `center` at the drawing's
origin, or centred on the drawing itself (`drawing`), following it.

thickness.description: Thickness, mm. Depths count down from the top.

z_zero.description: Where Z0 is: the stock `top` or `bottom`.

oneOf.description:
Centred on the drawing's outline, sticking out equally all round, and following the
drawing when it moves or changes (the user, 2026-10-28). Construction geometry
doesn't count; an empty drawing centres it on the origin.

at.description:
Tab centres placed by hand, in drawing coordinates (mm): a contour with points gets
exactly those tabs, one without gets `count`, evenly spaced. Left out when empty.

flank_angle.description:
The slope of the tab's sides, radians: π/2 (90°) straight, less for sloped tabs a
ramped profile follows.

height.description: The bridge's thickness, up from the bottom of the cut, mm.

width.description: The bridge left on the part, along its edge, mm (the flat top of a sloped tab).

Text.description:
A text written into shapes: what it says, its font and size, and where it goes. Its
letters are `path` shapes on its layer that name it in `text`, made again when it
changes; the font is needed only for that, not to cut them.

align.description: How the lines line up against each other.

anchor.description:
What `x` and `y` are: the box's lower-left corner (before the turn), or its centre.
A centred text stays centred there when its words, font or size change. Missing:
the corner.

font.description:
A built-in font: FreeSans, FreeSans Bold, FreeSerif, FreeSerif Bold, FreeMono or
FreeMono Bold (`chipload text fonts`).

height.description: The height of a capital letter, mm.

id.description: The text's id, which its letters name.

layer.description: The layer its letters go on.

line_spacing.description: From one line's base to the next, in capital heights.

rotation.description:
Turned counter-clockwise about the box's centre, degrees, at least 0 and less than
360.

spacing.description: Extra space between letters, mm; 0: the font's own spacing, kerning included.

text.description: What it says; a line break ("\n") starts a new line.

x.description:
X of the text's anchor on the stock, mm: the lower-left corner of its box (before
the turn) or its centre.

y.description: Y of the text's anchor on the stock, mm.

TextAlign.description: How a text's lines line up.

oneOf.description: The lower-left corner of the text's box, before the turn.
The centre of the text's box (the turn keeps it in place).

angle.description: V-bits: the included angle, radians. Null: unknown; a V-carve then refuses the tool.

center_cutting.description:
Whether it can plunge straight down. False: profiles ramp in and pockets go down
round a helix. Null: unknown.

diameter.description: Diameter, mm. For a V-bit, its widest cutting diameter.

flutes.description: Number of flutes, for the chip load. Null: unknown.

id.description: The tool's number: what operations name it by, and its T number in the G-code.

library_uid.description:
The `uid` of the library tool it came from, for reference; nothing that cuts reads
it. Null: not from the library.

name.description: The library tool it came from, for reference.

rpm.description: Spindle speed, rpm. Needed to generate.

tip_diameter.description: V-bits: the flat tip's diameter, mm. Null: pointed.

ToolChange.description: How a job with several tools is written.

oneOf.description: One G-code file per tool group; the user changes the tool and sets Z zero between.
One file with `T<n> M6` at each change, for a sender that handles it.
Declared by the file: a DXF's $INSUNITS, an SVG's size in real units.
The file declared none; the user chose (a DXF's units, an SVG's pixels per inch).

Wall.description: One of a corner's two walls, by length.

WorkZero.description: Where the G-code's X0 Y0 is. The geometry never moves; only the output is translated.

oneOf.description:
The drawing's own origin (the only choice before work_zero existed). An empty struct
variant, not a unit one, so serde refuses stray fields here too.
A corner or the centre of the stock, as placed by `stock.origin`.
Any point, in drawing coordinates (mm).

x.description: X of the point, drawing coordinates, mm.

y.description: Y of the point, drawing coordinates, mm.

description: Schema version 33. Older files load through Chipload's migrations; this schema describes only the current version.

active_part.description:
The part new operations go into (its id). Null or no such part: the first part.
Only the app and the command line read it; it changes nothing that is cut.

drawing.description: The drawing: the shapes Chipload cuts, imported from a DXF or drawn in Chipload.

machine.description: The machine: post-processor, safe height, limits and zero.

operations.description: The operations, cut in this order: grouped by part, in the parts' order.

parts.description:
The parts: groups of operations, each cut with its copies before the next part.
At least one.
